blocks.content: Atal Pension Yojana guarantees a fixed monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 for unorganised sector workers starting at age 60.

items: Age Eligibility: Open to Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a minimum 20-year contribution period.
Regulating Authority: Administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) through the NPS architecture.
Tax Payer Exclusion: Effective from October 1, 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income tax payer is ineligible to join APY.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) provides targeted social security and guaranteed pension to workers in the unorganised sector.
Subscribers receive a guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 upon attaining the age of 60 years.
The scheme requires a minimum contribution period of 20 years or more by the subscriber.
Upon the subscriber's death, the pension amount continues to the spouse, and post the spouse's death, the total corpus is returned to the nominee.
